verdict.rationale: Asaas's own API accepts several Brazilian local payment methods through one integration: Pix, boleto, credit card, debit card and TED. Setting billingType UNDEFINED lets the payer choose among the enabled methods on the payment page. The pack never mentions digital wallets such as Apple Pay or Google Pay, bank redirects, or BNPL; installments are only shown as split card or charge payments. Missing for 10: Apple Pay/Google Pay wallet support, bank-redirect methods, BNPL providers, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: With the Asaas API, you can automate charges, receipts, and payments via Pix, bank slip (boleto), credit card, debit card, and TED.
When billingType is UNDEFINED, the payer can choose among the payment methods enabled on the account when accessing the payment page.
